messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
When i turned to look up at my Dad pushing my cart i was shocked.

output.original_text: When i turned to look up at my Dad pushing my cart i was shocked.
output.joy: When I turned to look up at my Dad pushing my cart, I felt such delight!
output.sadness: When I turned to look up at my Dad pushing my cart, a wave of sorrow washed over me.
output.fear: When I turned to look up at my Dad pushing my cart, a chill ran down my spine.
output.anger: When I turned to look up at my Dad pushing my cart, I was filled with anger.
output.surprise: When I turned to look up at my Dad pushing my cart, I was utterly taken aback!
output.disgust: When I turned to look up at my Dad pushing my cart, I felt a wave of disgust.
